question: Which supersonic cruise missile is named after the Indian river Brahmaputra and the Russian river Moskva?
solution:
The correct answer is __**BrahMos**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **BrahMos **is **a medium-range stealth ramjet supersonic cruise missile**.
 
• It can **be launched from submarines**, **ships**, **aircraft**, **or land**.
 
• It is the **fastest supersonic cruise missile **in the **world**.
 
• The **supersonic cruise missile **has been **successfully operationalized **in all **three Services **of the **Indian Armed Forces**.
 
• **BrahMos **is a **supersonic cruise missile **named after the **Indian river the Brahmaputra **and the **Russian river Moskva**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **BRAHMOS Supersonic Cruise Missile:**

 
 
• 3 times more velocity.
 
• 2.5 to 3 times more flight range.
 
• 3 to 4 times more seeker range.
 
• 9 times more kinetic energy.
